text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> INC-2026-4821 fired for embeddings-service (us-west-2). Symptom: sustained 5xx spike (~18%) across hosted embeddings API. Auto-page to oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-4821

charlie: ack — taking it. digging now.

matt: tagging @sara for customer comms — any high-visibility customers impacted?

charlie: quick summary: elevated 5xx for ~3m. traces point to KV cache write NPE on worker-5. infra looks fine (CPU/Mem). One big customer (~1k calls) saw failures, overall ~15-20% fail rate.

priya: @charlie if autoscaler is saturated we should spin fallback pool in eu and route there. also consider temporary per-client rate limits to cut retry storms.

charlie: running temporary mitigations now. executing route flip + rate-limit:
```
rbctl route set embeddings us-west-2 --to fallback-pool --immediate
rbctl config set embeddings.rate_limit.per_client 5/s
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-2026-4821 acknowledged by charlie. Escalation level remains 1.

sara: I'll prepare CS notes for any customers >5% error, drafting message now.

eng-sre-bot: Autoscaler note: burst detected; no spare instances available in us-west-2 due to infra capacity. Recommend L3 if capacity doesn't free up.

charlie: route flip executed, monitoring metrics.

priya: also paused background ingestion to avoid queue saturation: `kubectl -n embeddings scale deployment/ingest-worker --replicas=0; sleep 10; kubectl scale --replicas=2 deployment/ingest-worker`

matt: ETA to recovery?

charlie: error rate dropping. last 2m avg ~3.2% down from 18%. worker-5 errors reduced after route.

incident-bot: PagerDuty automatic escalation check: timeout window approaching — escalating to level 2 if no owner change. Paging level 2.

priya: I see the escalation — taking over for validation. @charlie handoff ok?

charlie: handing off to priya. Handoff notes & commands logged in incident doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-4821

sara: CS update posted to #customer-status-digest. Flagged: AcmeCorp + DataSpark for targeted outreach.

priya: running cross-region sanity checks and request replays. Will post status pings every 10m.

matt: any config changes needing rollback later?

charlie: only temporary route flip + rate-limit. No code changes. Plan: keep for 30m then evaluate.

priya: after 12m stability check: 5xx -> 0.7%. Recommend keep route flip for another 20m, then rollback if stable. Opening postmortem ticket and assigning follow-up to eng-sre.

eng-sre-bot: Follow-up created: ENG-1829 — investigate worker-5 NPE under cache write contention. Owner: priya. ETA: 3 business days.

sara: customer comms sent, asked impacted customers to retry and offered escalation if they still see issues. No customer escalations so far.

charlie: closing on-call thread here. Handing long-term troubleshooting to priya & ENG-1829. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

priya: closing incident on PagerDuty, will collect logs and start postmortem draft. Final note: keep an eye on fallback-pool costs while route flip is active.
